decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing enchantments like Parallax Wave and Parallax Tide to control the board while setting up for a game-winning combo with Opalescence and Replenish. The goal is to quickly fill up the graveyard with enchantments using cards like Attunement and Frantic Search, then bring them back all at once with Replenish to overwhelm the opponent. Cards like Tsabo's Web and Seal of Cleansing provide additional ways to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while Swords to Plowshares helps deal with any problematic creatures that may arise.

The focus of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's hand and board with various discard spells like Cabal Therapy and Duress, while using The Rack and Bottomless Pit to put pressure on their hand size. Additionally, control the board with removal spells like Innocent Blood and Snuff Out. Generate additional mana with Dark Ritual to play threats like Hypnotic Specter and Skittering Skirge, while utilizing Mishra's Factory and Wasteland for additional disrupting plays. Overall, the key strategy is to lock down the opponent's resources and overwhelm them with constant pressure.

This deck focuses on playing aggressive Goblins to quickly overwhelm the opponent. With cards like Goblin Lackey and Goblin Matron to search for key creatures, along with support from Goblin Warchief to make them cheaper to play, the deck aims to flood the board with creatures like Goblin Piledriver and Mogg Fanatic. The deck also includes removal options like Gempalm Incinerator and Goblin Sharpshooter to control the board while disrupting the opponent's strategy. With mana denial from cards like Rishadan Port and Wasteland, the deck aims to keep the pressure on and secure a fast victory.

The deck revolves around utilizing Tortured Existence and Survival of the Fittest to constantly fill the graveyard with creatures and maintain card advantage. The strategy focuses on survival and control through efficient creature removal and disruption with cards like Cabal Therapy. The deck also includes a variety of versatile creatures that can be brought back from the graveyard or discarded for value. The mana base is designed to provide flexibility and consistency in casting spells. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent through smart resource management and strategic plays.

The main concept of the deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive goblin tribal strategy. By utilizing cards like Goblin Lackey and Goblin Matron to quickly put creatures on the battlefield and cards like Goblin King and Siege-Gang Commander to pump up and support the goblin army, the deck aims to quickly deal damage and overrun the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize. Additionally, cards like Rishadan Port and Wasteland are included to disrupt the opponent's mana base and slow down their game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through countering spells, removing threats, and stalling the opponent with cards like Standstill. The deck also focuses on locking down the opponent's mana resources through land destruction and creating card advantage through cards like Fact or Fiction. Ultimately, the goal is to control the board and outvalue the opponent until you can overwhelm them with powerful finishers like Decree of Justice.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by utilizing counterspells, removal spells, and card draw to maintain board control. The deck focuses on using cards like Standstill and Landstill to slow down the opponent's game plan while also disrupting their strategy through counterspells and removal. The deck also utilizes cards like Parallax Tide and Decree of Justice to generate advantage and control the pace of the game. By effectively managing resources and disrupting the opponent's game plan, this deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent to secure victory.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while controlling the game tempo through counterspells and removal spells. The Psychatog serves as the win condition, utilizing card advantage and graveyard manipulation to build up its power and take down the opponent. The deck also includes card draw and selection tools to ensure consistency and versatility in gameplay. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the deck's color requirements and maintain a balance between the different card types. Overall, the deck aims to outsmart and outlast its opponent through careful decision-making and resource management.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of countering spells, removing threats, and disrupting opponents' strategies while also growing its own threats to eventually overwhelm the opponent. It aims to leverage card advantage and efficient plays to maintain control of the board and outvalue the opponent over time. The deck includes a mix of disruptive elements, card draw, removal spells, and threats to create a versatile game plan that can adapt to different matchups and situations.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm your opponent with a swarm of aggressive goblin creatures, utilizing cards like Goblin Lackey, Goblin Piledriver, and Goblin Warchief to quickly build a strong board presence. Cards like Rishadan Port and Wasteland can disrupt your opponent's mana base, while Siege-Gang Commander and Goblin Sharpshooter provide additional damage and control options. With a mix of creature buffs, removal, and resource denial, this deck aims to apply constant pressure and finish off the opponent before they can stabilize.

The focus of this deck is to control the game through counterspells, removal, and board wipes, while utilizing the Standstill enchantment to create card advantage. The deck aims to lock down the opponent's game plan while slowly building up a board presence with efficient threats like Mishra's Factory and Faerie Conclave. By stalling the game and controlling the board, the deck creates a situation where it can eventually overwhelm the opponent with powerful late-game finishers like Decree of Justice.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by using counterspells and removal to disrupt the opponent's strategy. It also aims to generate card advantage through cards like Fact or Fiction and Impulse. The key strategy revolves around playing Standstill to lock down the game, while utilizing powerful control elements like Wrath of God and Swords to Plowshares to maintain board control. The deck also includes utility lands like Mishra's Factory and Dust Bowl to further control the game by limiting the opponent's resources. Additionally, it has a win condition in Decree of Justice to close out the game.

This deck is focused on quickly dealing damage to the opponent using cheap and efficient creatures and burn spells. With a low mana curve and high aggression, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent and win the game as quickly as possible. The inclusion of cards like Ball Lightning and Grim Lavamancer ensure that the pressure is kept on the opponent throughout the game. The deck's strategy is to maintain a fast pace and finish off the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize or gain control of the game.

The deck focuses on locking down the opponent's board with the Stasis enchantment while consistently drawing cards and dealing damage with Howling Mine and Black Vise. Counterspells and bounce spells help protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to maintain control of the game through card advantage and resource denial until it can win the game with a well-timed combo finish.

The deck focuses on quickly playing Phyrexian Dreadnought and using Stifle effects to counter any attempts to remove it from the battlefield. By combining efficient counterspells, card draw, and bounce effects, the deck aims to protect its combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The key strategy is to assemble the combo as quickly as possible while keeping the opponent off balance through disruptive spells and maintaining card advantage.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize aggressive creatures like Terravore and Werebear, along with powerful spells like Armageddon and Cataclysm, to quickly overwhelm the opponent while also disrupting their mana base with cards like Wasteland and Mox Diamond. The deck aims to control the board through efficient removal spells such as Swords to Plowshares and Mana Leak, while also providing card advantage with cards like Fact or Fiction and Sylvan Library. Additionally, the inclusion of Propaganda helps to protect the player and stall the game until they can establish a dominant board presence.
